todos.ask: Find the current weather in Lisbon. Answer with the temperature and one or two words, like "18°C, sunny".
Find the population of Portugal. Answer with the number, like "10.4 million".

noteWritten.request: In Notes, which is already open and in front, make a new note titled Todo with a checklist of two items: "Weather in Lisbon" and "Population of Portugal". When the note is written, call done.

helperRuns.request: Find the current weather in Lisbon. Answer with the temperature and one or two words, like "18°C, sunny". Use Safari. Search the web from its address bar. When you have the answer, call report with it, then done.
Find the population of Portugal. Answer with the number, like "10.4 million". Use Google Chrome. Search the web from its address bar. When you have the answer, call report with it, then done.

crossRuns.request: In Notes, in the note called Todo, add " — 18°C, cloudy" to the end of the checklist item "Weather in Lisbon" and tick that item. Leave the other item alone. Then call done.
In Notes, in the note called Todo, add " — 11.4 million" to the end of the checklist item "Population of Portugal" and tick that item. Leave the other item alone. Then call done.
